mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.3% within 3 months signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over 3 months signals a strengthening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of overall economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over 3 months signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to increased prices and reduced corporate profits, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 1%) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of the instances where FEDFUNDS is below 1%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) combined with an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 0.5% over 3 months signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases & PAYEMS increases > 0.5% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A regime-conditional signal where a rise in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) by more than 1% during a period of low inflation (CPIAUCSL < 2%) signals real demand growth without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% over 3 months signals supply-side inflationary pressures, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases & CPIAUCSL increases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
